name: timetrack
description: Automatic billable-time tracking for Claude Code: a pausable timer per session, auto-pause when the agent goes idle, projects matched by repository, and TimeTrack MCP tools to edit entries, log work notes and build client timesheets.

api_key.title: TimeTrack API key
api_key.description: Create one in TimeTrack under Settings → API keys. It starts with tt_.

api_url.title: TimeTrack API URL
api_url.description: Leave the default unless you run your own TimeTrack server.

import_history.title: Import past sessions
import_history.description: On the first session after install, import your last 30 days of Claude Code sessions (timestamps, repos and token counts only — never prompts or code).
